#OpenSSH #SSHole #CVE2026123158 #AlpineLinux #Cybersecurity #InfoSec

external.description: Malicious actors began exploiting a newly disclosed secure shell flaw in less than nine hours. Specifically, threat groups targeted the critical OpenSSH SSHole vulnerability across global internet infrastructure. Researchers confirmed active penetration attempts against realistic decoy systems running Alpine Linux. Furthermore, attackers successfully seized root privileges on compromised nodes. Consequently, system administrators must apply available vendor patches immediately to safeguard operational environments.

An $11.4M Nvidia shipment stolen after an Oakland pickup is still missing. Here is what police know, the theft pattern, and what remains unclear.

#Nvidia #NvidiaShipmentStolen #CargoTheft #PlusAI #Oakland

external.description: Six pallets of Nvidia hardware, worth about $11.4 million, left Oakland on Aug. 29 and never reached Texas. More than two months later, no one has been arrested. Police also have not said how the cargo was taken. The case shows how cargo thieves now work. They are making fewer hits, but each one is worth far more. High-value computer gear sits near the top of their list.
